title: One colour for Spent on a phone
caption: At Lv 4 Next up's Spent button is now green on a phone too, as it is on a wide screen.

title: The E row stays on a phone row
caption: At Lv 22 with a shard, the Equip Triniel's Dagger row on a phone now cuts the start and keeps "then put it on E, row 0 (fires first)" whole.

title: Key setup shows only equipped stigmas
caption: At Lv 25 with no stigma equipped, E no longer shows Triniel's Dagger; Coming to E lists it with its row.
